## 🌎 Geopolitics

### US shifts to economic siege on Iran—Rubio says sanctions alone will collapse Tehran's economy

Secretary of State Marco Rubio declared this week that the Trump administration has no near-term need for fresh military strikes on Iran, as economic sanctions and a naval blockade are already "devastating" the regime. Rubio, speaking at the G7 summit in Paris, predicted Iran's total economic collapse within one to three months as Washington tightens the screws on oil exports, border trade, and foreign exchange. A blockade and maximum sanctions pressure will continue indefinitely with no defined endpoint.

**Why it matters.** India faces direct macro headwinds from this shift. Iranian oil and trade flows already constrain energy prices in South Asia, and if Tehran's economy enters full collapse mode, capital flight and instability ripple through BRICS, Gulf remittances, and regional commodity markets. Geopolitically, a weakened but still-nuclear Iran raises calculus for proxy conflicts across the Indian Ocean rim—affecting both energy security and your consulting clients' near-term exposure models. The shift from kinetic action to economic strangulation also signals the Trump 2.0 playbook: coercive pressure without direct US casualties, which could become the template for China and Russia policy as well.

**Action.** Watch the Al Jazeera and Reuters reports on Iran's oil blockade for monthly export figures and FX reserves burn-rate—those are the real-time scorecards. Track OMR and INR volatility against oil futures; CEIC India data on remittance inflows and inflation will telegraphs second-order Iran pressure on Indian supply chains within two months.

*Sources: [english.aawsat.com](https://english.aawsat.com/world/5339816-rubio-says-no-need-major-combat-operations-against-iran-given-us-economic-campaign) · [aljazeera.com](https://www.aljazeera.com/economy/2026/11/11/can-tehran-survive-a-zero-oil-budget-if-us-blockade-on-iran-persists) · [freepresskashmir.news](https://freepresskashmir.news/2026/11/11/rubio-says-us-sanctions-inflicting-extraordinary-economic-pain-on-iran/)*

### China rehearses Taiwan blockade with 100+ warships—largest exercise since December 2025 signals readiness to isolate island

The People's Liberation Army conducted an unannounced exercise in early November involving over 100 Navy and Coast Guard vessels across the western Pacific, with forces practicing naval encirclement of Taiwan in what Taipei officials characterize as a blockade-readiness drill. Three separate task groups, including the carrier Liaoning, coordinated from three theater commands to simulate severing Taiwan's maritime lifelines and denying external reinforcement. By November 13, approximately 70 vessels remained inside the first island chain, down from the peak deployment.

**Why it matters.** This is the clearest signal yet that Beijing has weaponized naval scale as a coercion tool independent of political events—the drill was unannounced and pre-positioned, not reactive. For your consulting work and quant models, it reframes Taiwan risk from binary (invasion yes/no) to scalar (slow strangulation that courts can ignore). Energy markets care because a Taiwan blockade scenario would freeze Taiwan Strait chokepoint data into risk premiums within hours, crunching semiconductor margins and pushing Asia power prices north immediately. India's semiconductor and energy exposure to Taiwan means this is no longer a cross-strait curiosity but a near-term macro driver.

**Action.** Add a Taiwan Strait "closure probability" tracker to your briefing dashboards—watch Taiwan defense ministry statements, US Navy 7th Fleet operations, and semi conductor spot LNG prices at Keppel terminal as leading indicators. Monitor ISW (Institute for the Study of War) Taiwan assessments and CSIS Critical Chokepoints data for blockade scenario modeling.

*Sources: [france24.com](https://www.france24.com/en/asia-pacific/20261113-chinese-army-military-exercises-taiwan) · [taipeitimes.com](https://www.taipeitimes.com/News/taiwan/archives/2026/11/13/2003867684) · [moderndiplomacy.eu](https://moderndiplomacy.eu/2026/11/13/could-china-blockade-taiwan-naval-drills-raise-fears-of-a-wider-indo-pacific-crisis/)*

## 🧠 Artificial Intelligence

### Claude Fable 5.2 Tops Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index With 65-Point Lead, METR Confirms 50%+ Across All Benchmarks

Anthropic's Claude Fable 5.2 launched in early November and scored 65 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index, outpacing Gemini 4 Carbon at 60. Independent evaluation by METR found the model achieved above 50% on every benchmark in its test suite, while Anthropic's AECI benchmark scores have improved at 1.9 times their pre-October 2025 rate.

**Why it matters.** The 65-point spread on a consensus index signals sustained gains in reasoning and long-horizon task handling. For teams building multi-step inference systems, the uniform >50% floor across benchmarks (rather than peaks on narrow domains) suggests broad generalist improvements rather than task-specific tuning. The 1.9x acceleration in AECI improvements indicates Anthropic's optimization pipeline is still extracting gains; for LLMOps planning, this velocity matters when forecasting benchmark saturation. The score gap also implies architecture implications—multi-step problems may now require fewer intermediate checkpoints when using Fable 5.2.

**Action.** Run your internal benchmark suite against Fable 5.2 and Gemini 4 Carbon in head-to-head mode, paying special attention to long-context and multi-step reasoning tasks where the gap likely concentrates. If you operate Anthropic models in production, measure whether the improvement justifies prompt rewrites or agentic loop restructuring. For teams designing autonomous agent architectures, the margin suggests Fable 5.2 may reduce the cost of self-correction loops.

*Sources: [[Anthropic's Claude Tops AI Rankings as OpenAI Limits Cyber Model](https://www.pymnts.com/news/artificial-intelligence/2026/anthropics-claude-tops-ai-rankings-as-openai-limits-cyber-model/)]([Anthropic's Claude Tops AI Rankings as OpenAI Limits Cyber Model](https://www.pymnts.com/news/artificial-intelligence/2026/anthropics-claude-tops-ai-rankings-as-openai-limits-cyber-model/)) · [[AI News Today, November 15: Top Stories](https://aiweekly.co/ai-news-today)]([AI News Today, November 15: Top Stories](https://aiweekly.co/ai-news-today)) · [[Latest AI breakthroughs News](https://blog.mean.ceo/latest-ai-breakthroughs-news-november-2026/)]([Latest AI breakthroughs News](https://blog.mean.ceo/latest-ai-breakthroughs-news-november-2026/))*

### Gemini Robotics 2.5 Hits 96% on Live Mercedes-Benz Assembly Lines—First Large-Scale Multimodal Validation in Automotive

Google DeepMind deployed Gemini Robotics 2.5 on live Mercedes-Benz production lines and achieved 96% first-pass success on parts sorting and placement. The deployment marks the first documented high-volume multimodal-vision-to-motor inference in automotive manufacturing and ran alongside human workers in uncontrolled lighting and changeover conditions.

**Why it matters.** The 96% real-world success rate (not synthetic data) closes the grounding gap that has historically blocked robotics commercialization. For manufacturers, this validates that end-to-end vision-language models handle manufacturing's hard cases—partial occlusion, lighting variance, rapid SKU changes—without per-line fine-tuning. For ML infrastructure teams, the fact that this is live (not piloted) implies regulatory approval and insurance have moved; latency budgets and network robustness have matured enough for production. The 4% failure mode—whether it clusters by part geometry/lighting or is uniform random—determines whether fixes are prompt engineering, architectural, or data-driven.

**Action.** If you architect manufacturing or logistics workflows, contact Google's robotics partnerships team for Robotics 2.5 access. Validate latency budgets for real-time motor control and distribution-shift robustness (new parts, seasonal variants). For computer-vision and robotics engineers, reverse-engineer the failure modes: request failure logs and evaluate whether they cluster predictably or require architectural mitigation.

*Sources: [[AI News Today, November 15: Top Stories](https://aiweekly.co/ai-news-today)]([AI News Today, November 15: Top Stories](https://aiweekly.co/ai-news-today)) · [[Google DeepMind Partnership Newsroom](https://deepmind.google/news/)]([Google DeepMind Partnership Newsroom](https://deepmind.google/news/))*

## 🇮🇳 India

### SEBI Charts AI Governance Rules for Capital Markets, Mandating Human Oversight and Risk Disclosures

India's markets regulator SEBI announced on November 14, 2026, at the India International Trade Fair (IITF) that it is finalizing AI guidelines for capital markets, building on a June 2025 consultation paper on responsible AI deployment in securities markets. Chairman Tuhin Kanta Pandey told regulators from other countries that the new rules will center on investor protection, mandatory AI disclosures by brokers and fund managers, and a human-in-the-loop requirement ensuring critical trading and investment decisions remain under human supervision. SEBI also flagged cybersecurity safeguards as a non-negotiable pillar of the framework.

**Why it matters.** For any AI engineer or fintech founder working on algorithmic trading, portfolio optimization, or market surveillance tools in India, these rules mean compliance becomes mandatory from day one. The human-in-the-loop requirement cuts across all models—even black-box algorithms will need human traders, risk officers, or compliance teams to approve or override any AI-driven decision that moves money or affects positions. If you're building a quant fund or embedded an LLM into a trading desk, you'll need to audit model outputs, document decision trails, and prove your system didn't make unsupervised market moves. For Indian exchanges and brokers, this also means a compliance audit of every AI tool now in use: chatbots for client advice, robo-advisors, risk systems, everything.

**Action.** Watch for SEBI's formal circular and draft rules, expected before year-end 2026. If you're shipping any AI tool into Indian capital markets, flag the human-in-the-loop requirement with your product and legal teams immediately. Review SEBI's June 2025 consultation paper (available on sebi.gov.in) to map your product's AI flows against the principles flagged there—disclosures, audit trails, model explainability, and bias testing will likely be required. If you work on market data or surveillance, keep an eye on how SEBI's internal 'Sudarshan' AI tool (mentioned by Pandey) operates; it may set the baseline for what the regulator expects.

*Sources: [[Storyboard18](https://www.storyboard18.com/digital/sebi-to-issue-ai-guidelines-for-capital-markets-prioritise-investor-protection-114796.htm)]([Storyboard18](https://www.storyboard18.com/digital/sebi-to-issue-ai-guidelines-for-capital-markets-prioritise-investor-protection-114796.htm)) · [[India.com Business](https://www.india.com/business/attention-investors-sebi-to-issue-ai-usage-guidelines-for-capital-markets-focus-on-investor-protection-8545165/)]([India.com Business](https://www.india.com/business/attention-investors-sebi-to-issue-ai-usage-guidelines-for-capital-markets-focus-on-investor-protection-8545165/)) · [[Argus English](https://argusenglish.in/business/sebi-plans-ai-usage-guidelines-for-capital-markets-with-focus-on-investor-safety)]([Argus English](https://argusenglish.in/business/sebi-plans-ai-usage-guidelines-for-capital-markets-with-focus-on-investor-safety))*

### Bharat Semi Raises $24 Million to Build AI-Ready Semiconductor Sensors for Global Markets

Bengaluru-based Bharat Semi, an Indian semiconductor startup specializing in AI-enabled image sensors, closed a $24 million seed round on November 15, 2026, led by Info Edge Group (which also backs Zomato and PolicyBazaar), South Park Commons, and Indus Bridge Ventures. The startup is tackling a gap in India's semiconductor self-sufficiency by designing edge AI chips for visual computing—image sensors that run inference locally without sending raw data to the cloud. Bharat Semi's first product targets industrial and automotive applications, segments where latency-sensitive, privacy-respecting AI at the chip level is a core requirement.

**Why it matters.** This is the second major signal this year that India's startup ecosystem is moving upstream into semiconductors and AI silicon, not just applications. For AI engineers and founders, it means: (1) a potential new supply chain for edge-inference chips manufactured in India, reducing latency and data egress for computer-vision workloads; (2) a validation that Indian investors and global VCs see semiconductor deeptech as fundable and defensible; (3) a hiring pipeline forming—Bharat Semi will likely recruit silicon engineers, ML ops people, and hardware-software integration specialists. If you're building autonomous vehicles, robotics, or surveillance systems in India, watch Bharat Semi's roadmap; they could become a critical vendor within 18–24 months.

**Action.** Follow Bharat Semi's product timeline and sample availability; foundational AI chip plays can take 18–30 months from funding to first revenue. Check their career page for engineering roles—the talent they hire will shape India's chip-design capability in the next cycle. If you're a founder building any AI product that needs visual inference, request a technical deep-dive on their sensor roadmap to map architecture early.

*Sources: [[TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/11/15/indian-chip-startup-bharat-semi-lands-24m-seed-round-as-it-eyes-global-ai-sensor-market/)]([TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/11/15/indian-chip-startup-bharat-semi-lands-24m-seed-round-as-it-eyes-global-ai-sensor-market/))*

## 💹 Global Stocks

### NVDA (NASDAQ): -12.8% weekly after CEO Jensen Huang's resignation over personal conduct disclosures

Nvidia shares fell 14.4% at Thursday's open and 2.01% Friday to close at approximately $148.80 after Jensen Huang announced his resignation as CEO on November 12, marking a 12.75% weekly decline—the stock's sixth consecutive weekly loss and worst streak since 2012. Colette Kress, the CFO, is serving as interim CEO while the board searches for a permanent replacement. The resignation followed New York Times reporting that Huang had engaged in affairs, including one with a woman whom U.S. intelligence officials believe is a Chinese spy.

**Why it matters.** The move signals leadership instability at the mega-cap anchoring AI chip enthusiasm and extends a broader weakness already underway—NVDA had lost over 20% in the prior month. The resignation pulls through the entire semiconductor complex: AMD and Broadcom fell sharply on the news, the Philadelphia semiconductor index shed 3.4% on Friday, and peer ASML dropped 1.6% intraday Thursday. For investors tracking foundry capacity buildouts and AI infrastructure spending, the executive vacuum raises questions about capex guidance continuity heading into Nvidia's earnings call Tuesday, November 17.

**Action.** Monitor Nvidia's November 17 earnings transcript for CFO Kress's remarks on capex expectations and interim management structure—any backward guidance on data-center capacity or 2027 revenue assumptions could weigh further. The board's permanent CEO search timeline (typically disclosed on 8-K filings) will be critical; external appointments can signal strategy shifts. Watch the semiconductor index (SOX) for Monday's open as a read on whether Friday's bounce holds or gives way to fresh selling on board governance concerns.

*Sources: [[CNBC: Jensen Huang resigns, stock closes down 4%](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/12/nvidia-nvda-jensen-huang-second-affair.html)]([CNBC: Jensen Huang resigns, stock closes down 4%](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/12/nvidia-nvda-jensen-huang-second-affair.html)) · [[The Hill: Stock plunges 14 percent](https://thehill.com/business/6215959-jensen-huang-resigns-nvidia-stock-drops/)]([The Hill: Stock plunges 14 percent](https://thehill.com/business/6215959-jensen-huang-resigns-nvidia-stock-drops/)) · [[CNBC: Market cap falls below $4T](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/13/nvidia-nvda-stock-jensen-huang-transition.html)]([CNBC: Market cap falls below $4T](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/13/nvidia-nvda-stock-jensen-huang-transition.html))*

### ASML (EURONEXT:ASML): +5.6% rebound amid chip recovery after Nvidia rout, guidance raised on AI capacity demand

ASML Holding shares rose 5.6% on November 9 as semiconductor and AI equities rebounded from earlier weakness, then dipped 1.6% intraday on November 12 as Nvidia's CEO resignation triggered a sector pullback before stabilizing near 1,495.16 EUR on Friday (down 0.13% for the session). The recovery reflects sustained demand for advanced lithography equipment from foundries racing to expand AI chip capacity.

**Why it matters.** ASML's equipment sits upstream of chip production—demand trends here forecast near-term foundry utilization and capex intensity across TSMC, Samsung, and Intel. The company raised its 2026 guidance earlier this month citing AI capacity acceleration, signaling that despite near-term volatility in mega-cap semis, the infrastructure layer continues pricing in sustained AI spending. For a global fund assessing which subsectors survive the Nvidia turmoil, ASML's firmness relative to edge-processor names suggests equipment suppliers hold their own cash flows even if customer guidance wavers.

**Action.** Obtain ASML's latest investor update (next earnings January 27, 2027) and track order backlog disclosures for visibility on 2027 capacity builds. Read Nvidia's November 17 call closely for any comments on capex acceleration or slowdown—any material reduction signals spillover risk to ASML's guidance. Check quarterly bookings data when released; year-over-year growth >15% would confirm foundry appetite remains intact despite board turbulence at Nvidia.

*Sources: [[FourWeekMBA: Europe chip stocks rise after Nvidia rout, ASML up 2.6%](https://fourweekmba.com/ai-europes-chip-stocks-rise-after-nvidia-rout-asml-up-2-6/)]([FourWeekMBA: Europe chip stocks rise after Nvidia rout, ASML up 2.6%](https://fourweekmba.com/ai-europes-chip-stocks-rise-after-nvidia-rout-asml-up-2-6/)) · [[Trading Key: ASML up 5.6% on Nov 9, chip rebound](https://www.tradingkey.com/news/market-movers/262296656-market-movers-asml-20261109/)]([Trading Key: ASML up 5.6% on Nov 9, chip rebound](https://www.tradingkey.com/news/market-movers/262296656-market-movers-asml-20261109/)) · [[GRU Focus: ASML stocks fall as Nvidia shake-up spills into chip equipment](https://www.gurufocus.com/news/9195156/asml-stocks-fall-as-nvidia-shakeup-spills-into-chip-equipment)]([GRU Focus: ASML stocks fall as Nvidia shake-up spills into chip equipment](https://www.gurufocus.com/news/9195156/asml-stocks-fall-as-nvidia-shakeup-spills-into-chip-equipment))*

## 🏗 Tech & Startups

### Bedrock Robotics Closes $600M Series C to Scale Autonomous Excavators

San Francisco-based Bedrock Robotics, which makes autonomous equipment for heavy construction, raised $600 million in Series C funding at a $4.1 billion post-money valuation on November 13. The round marks significant momentum for autonomous hardware in an industry that has historically resisted automation. Bedrock's platform retrofits existing excavators and dozers with autonomous control systems, letting operators run machines remotely or fully autonomously.

**Why it matters.** Construction automation is undergoing a step-change—labor shortages, safety mandates, and shrinking project timelines make autonomous dozers tangible. Bedrock is proving that hardware retrofits (not greenfield robots) win adoption faster; other founders in logistics, mining, and infrastructure should watch how they're pricing unit economics and winning early customers. The valuation climb ($2.4B → $4.1B in this round) signals that venture sees this as a durable, defensible moat.

**Action.** Track Bedrock's customer wins and utilization metrics—their Series C deck likely models per-hour fleet TCO versus operator costs. Read the investor thesis from their lead (Global Startups Insights reported the round but the lead backer wasn't named in my search); founders building in adjacent infrastructure verticals should ask why Bedrock won where earlier robo-construction startups stalled. Watch for any customer deployment announcements, which validate market fit faster than funding rounds.

*Sources: [[Bedrock Robotics raises $600M Series C](https://www.globalstartupsinsights.com)]([Bedrock Robotics raises $600M Series C](https://www.globalstartupsinsights.com)) · [[TechStartups Nov 13 funding roundup](https://techstartups.com/2026/11/13/startup-funding-news-today-november-13-2026-mirendil-langchain-luminal-kindo-q-ctrl-more)]([TechStartups Nov 13 funding roundup](https://techstartups.com/2026/11/13/startup-funding-news-today-november-13-2026-mirendil-langchain-luminal-kindo-q-ctrl-more))*

### Oister Global Launches ₹600 Crore Deeptech Fund, Backs Indian Scaleups in Space, Defence, Quantum

Mumbai-based Oister Global announced a new growth-stage fund with a target corpus of ₹600 crore (base ₹400 crore plus a ₹200 crore greenshoe option) on November 15. The SEBI-registered Category II AIF, with a six-year tenure, will focus on eight to ten mature deeptech companies in space, defence and aerospace, semiconductors, quantum technologies, and advanced materials. Oister notes nearly $3 billion has flowed into Indian deeptech startups across 189 deals in 2025.

**Why it matters.** Indian deeptech is maturing—capital is flowing past seed into growth stage, and operators are building sector-specific funds instead of generalist pools. This is a signal that India's defence and space startups are graduating to scaleup challenges (production, compliance, go-to-market) rather than just R&D. For founders in semiconductors or defence tech, the fund's focus on "commercial adoption and order execution" suggests LPs now expect revenue, not just tech breakthroughs. The timing (post-Ukraine) mirrors Western defence-tech capital surge.

**Action.** If you're running a deeptech scaleup in India targeting government or aerospace customers, study Oister's check size range and thesis—the greenshoe structure hints at conviction plays. Reach out to Oister's team directly; growth-stage deeptech founders should also track which eight to ten companies land in this fund's portfolio, as they'll set the benchmark for what "revenue-ready deeptech" looks like in India. Read Oister's prior thesis letters and portfolio to understand their pattern recognition.

*Sources: [[Business Standard: Oister Global launches ₹600 crore deeptech fund](https://www.business-standard.com/companies/start-ups/oister-global-launches-deep-tech-fund-with-potential-600-crore-corpus-126111500489_1.html)]([Business Standard: Oister Global launches ₹600 crore deeptech fund](https://www.business-standard.com/companies/start-ups/oister-global-launches-deep-tech-fund-with-potential-600-crore-corpus-126111500489_1.html)) · [[NewsBytes: Oister deeptech fund](https://www.newsbytesapp.com/news/business/oister-global-launches-rs600-cr-deeptech-fund-backing-indian-scaleups/tldr)]([NewsBytes: Oister deeptech fund](https://www.newsbytesapp.com/news/business/oister-global-launches-rs600-cr-deeptech-fund-backing-indian-scaleups/tldr)) · [[Indian Opinion: Oister fund launch](https://indianopinion.org/oister-global-launches-rs-600-crore-deep-tech-fund)]([Indian Opinion: Oister fund launch](https://indianopinion.org/oister-global-launches-rs-600-crore-deep-tech-fund))*

## 🎤 Culture & World

### Lionsgate Launches Hunger Games Prequel to Theatrical Stage as Franchise Wagers on Big-Screen Strategy

The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping opens November 20, 2026, four days from now, as a theatrical-only release from Lionsgate. Francis Lawrence directs this prequel to Suzanne Collins' novels, starring Joseph Zada as young Haymitch Abernathy and McKenna Grace as Maysilee Donner. The film adapts Collins' March 2025 novel and follows tributes in the 50th Games—the Second Quarter Quell, where each district sends twice as many competitors.

**Why it matters.** The Hunger Games property has established November as its release window since 2012, creating a theatrical anchor through franchise fatigue and streaming's growth. Lionsgate betting on a theatrical prequel signals that legacy IP can still command tentpole distribution; the franchise's last film, The Ballad of Songbirds and Snakes, arrived in November 2023. The decision to premiere this follow-up in theaters rather than as prestige streaming content (a path followed by other major properties) is a statement about theatrical resilience for literary adaptations with established fanbases—and a test of whether nostalgia-driven franchises can hold box office in a fractured release calendar.

**Action.** Track opening weekend box office and word-of-mouth sentiment from core Hunger Games audiences on social platforms; monitor whether franchise fatigue or curiosity about Haymitch's backstory drives attendance. The film's performance will signal whether studios still view prequel storytelling as theater-worthy or whether it should migrate to streaming platforms.

### Apple's Patreon In-App Billing Mandate Takes Effect, Forcing Creator Monetization Shift Mid-Month

November 1, 2026 marked Apple's deadline for Patreon to migrate all remaining creators to the App Store's in-app purchase system, a move that consolidates platform payment control and redirects revenue. Patreon objected publicly but announced compliance; only 4% of creators remained on the platform's legacy billing at the deadline, meaning most had already switched voluntarily. Apple threatened App Store removal if Patreon did not comply, cementing the tech giant's control over iOS subscription flows.

**Why it matters.** This is a second attempt—Apple previously set a November 2025 deadline, then delayed it—and it exemplifies how app store gatekeepers extract rent from creators. The 30% fee carved by Apple's in-app purchase system directly reduces creator earnings and reinforces platform dependency; even though only a small share of Patreon's base was affected, the regulatory signal matters. The move is part of a broader pattern: YouTube is rolling out creator shopping commissions in 35 markets by year-end, TikTok is experimenting with creator billing tools, and Twitch/Meta are adjusting payout models. Creators increasingly can't escape platform mediation.

**Action.** Monitor Patreon's public statements about post-November monetization, creator earnings reports, and any migration of affected creators to web-only subscriptions or alternative platforms. Watch for whether other platforms (Substack, Gumroad) face similar Apple pressure; if they do, a coordinated push by Apple to claim all recurring payments would signal a fundamental shift in creator economics.

*Sources: [[Engadget](https://www.engadget.com/big-tech/patreon-creators-have-to-switch-to-subscription-billing-by-november-thanks-to-apple-203759852.html)]([Engadget](https://www.engadget.com/big-tech/patreon-creators-have-to-switch-to-subscription-billing-by-november-thanks-to-apple-203759852.html)) · [[Yahoo Finance](https://finance.yahoo.com/news/apple-tells-patreon-move-creators-174500696.html)]([Yahoo Finance](https://finance.yahoo.com/news/apple-tells-patreon-move-creators-174500696.html)) · [[MacRumors](https://www.macrumors.com/2026/01/28/patreon-apple-tax/)]([MacRumors](https://www.macrumors.com/2026/01/28/patreon-apple-tax/)) · [[Net Influencer](https://www.netinfluencer.com/patreon-faces-november-deadline-to-move-all-creators-to-apple-in-app-billing/)]([Net Influencer](https://www.netinfluencer.com/patreon-faces-november-deadline-to-move-all-creators-to-apple-in-app-billing/))*
